current_source_facts: ArenaBuf owns private Box<[T]> and private cached pointer; one constructor fills every entry with T::default.
Only slice,write_at,as_slice,as_mut_slice expose mutable access or a borrowed view/pointer escape. read_at returns a value; len/is_empty expose metadata only.

Solver::with_storage constructs four default-filled arenas without inspecting quantized values. GPU ArenaLayout construction uses layout metadata before can_upload_zeros.

proposed_invariant: A sticky per-buffer atomic starts true only after default allocation succeeds; conservatively invalidate before any quantized borrowed-view or mutable access escapes, including read-only as_slice because its pointer can escape. Never re-enable after access, even if data is restored to zero. Treat by-value primitive reads as non-escaping. Moves preserve the flag with the owner. Concurrent disjoint users must not race a non-atomic flag.
generic_type_limit: Default is not generally zero. Only i16/u16 use the zero inference. Consider cfg(gpu) tracking and a compile-time type-size path so F32 and CPU-only hot accessors do not acquire per-access atomic work; actual final-build code/cost must be checked. No unsafe pointer-tag scheme or iteration==0 assumption.
possible_costs: Extra atomic read/branch in compressed CPU accessors, generic object size/alignment and code generation. No free/no-tradeoff claim.
Conservative read-only invalidation forfeits optimization after inspection; original exact scan remains the fallback.
Skipped cold q reads can shift page/cache/first-touch work into readback. Whole-cycle/process measurements must include that, not preparation-only savings.
